baseline_audit.storyboard_shot_schema: models/storyboard.py: relational display/execution fields plus legacy prompt/media fields and meta_info
downstream_consumers: api/server.py (Prompt Compiler, media submission, QA, export, continuity and readiness consumers)
tests/* (materializer, prompt compiler, media and QA contracts)
baseline_audit.revision_identity: Before this stage, production relied on meta_info shot_plan_ref and scene-name queries; no set-level current pointer existed.
baseline_audit.old_storyboard_invalidation: Old rows had no explicit set or pointer state; revision changes could only be detected indirectly.
baseline_audit.production_readiness_baseline: mixed storyboard/Prompt Compiler/asset/media gates and production_status; materialization was not a first-class authority artifact.

final_as_built_verification.materialization_set: StoryboardMaterializationSet with ShotPlan id/revision/hash/authority fingerprint, cardinality, ordered ids, set fingerprint, versions, envelope, status and stale state.
final_as_built_verification.current_pointer: StoryboardMaterializationPointer keyed by book_id + episode + scene_id; production never infers current rows from scene_name/latest shot.
final_as_built_verification.shot_plan_lineage: Current ShotPlanAuthority envelope is the authority source; ScriptIR, Treatment, SceneBlocking are exact lineage defense-in-depth checks.
final_as_built_verification.projection_policy: Pure deterministic N-to-N projection; no Prompt Compiler invocation and no creative rewriting.
final_as_built_verification.fallback_policy: Production strict mode rejects missing scene_id, plan_shot_id, camera, duration, action_beats, entry/exit state, asset bindings, continuity contract and purpose. Legacy permissive mode is isolated to non-production callers.
final_as_built_verification.idempotency: Same authority envelope + materializer/policy versions + ordered projection fingerprint reuses a complete fresh set and never creates duplicate StoryboardShot rows.
final_as_built_verification.legacy_migration: Rows without scene_id/materialization_set_id/plan_shot_id/authority lineage fail closed with LEGACY_STORYBOARD_MIGRATION_REQUIRED.
final_as_built_verification.prompt_compiler_handoff: Each authoritative StoryboardShot stores a downstream-only prompt_compiler_handoff containing set id, shot id, plan identity, authority/projection fingerprints, asset bindings, continuity, camera, duration, action beats and entry/exit state. Prompt fields remain empty during materialization.
final_as_built_verification.production_status: MATERIALIZED/quality materialized but production_status remains blocked until downstream PromptIR, assets and media gates pass.
final_as_built_verification.visual_asset_backlog: Stable asset identity and pending bindings are preserved; visual authoring/reference generation remains out of scope.
final_as_built_verification.production_writes: Only local authoritative materialization rows/set/pointer are written after confirmed=true; no external provider or media writes.
